name: Beastman Warrior
description: Beastmen are savage brutes that infest the forests of the Empire: massive horned creatures with a furious temper and an inhuman resistance to pain.

abilities.name: Bestial Rage
abilities.text: Whenever this fighter has any damage points allocated to it, you must increase its Attacks characteristic by 1, and reduce its Defense characteristic by 1.

abilities.name: Endure
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by an attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1) from that attack action.

abilities.name: Headlong Charge
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if there is an enemy fighter within 6" of it. This fighter makes a free Move action, and must end that move action within 1" of that enemy fighter. Then, inflict (X/2) damage points to that enemy fighter.
